items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Handy' in the context of timeline comparisons ('Was he before Handy or?') and other musicians' histories, but does not claim a direct personal or professional relationship with Handy himself.
